name: TrueWood Natural Oak Slats, Black Felt
summary: Solid rubberwood core wrapped in real natural oak veneer on all three visible sides, with black acoustic felt backing.

texture.note: No manufacturer spec sheet was published; photos suggest 7 slats per recorded 11.8 in panel, estimated 1.12 in faces and 0.566 in rectangular felt gaps on a 1.686 in pitch with lightly softened edges, while 0.75 in total thickness is from the panel record. Tile covers 7 pitches by 23.6 in; muted natural oak veneer colors and charcoal black felt are matched to the main photo, with structure checked against the gallery.
